messages:
maria_partnerships: Quick ask — NexusCloud just sent final hero image + their logo for the joint solution brief. Can design confirm lockup and badging? They specifically requested a small badge that says ‘Powered by Redwood Inference’ in the lower-right. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/Nexus-Redwood-Hero (preview attached by assets-bot)

kara_design: Taking a look now. Quick Q — does Nexus want the two logos touching or separated with a divider? Also want to avoid overlapping CTA.

devin_marketing: They also sent a quote from their CTO: “Redwood made our inference 3x faster and 50% cheaper.” Is that final copy? Legal needs source/consent.

sachin_legal: Not approved as-is. Need written confirmation from Nexus legal that the quote can be used verbatim, plus the source metric backing. Also brand rules: we prefer “Built with Redwood Inference” text per our badge guidance — avoids implying endorsement.

maria_partnerships: Felix already asked Nexus PM to confirm metrics and legal signoff — waiting response. They want the smaller badge (no big co-branded lockup) so separation should be fine.

kara_design: Cool. I sketched two options: (A) logos separated with thin vertical rule and small caption line under partner logo, (B) single compact lockup with divider and tiny Redwood badge bottom-right. Uploaded frames to Figma. My recommended spacing: 24px from edges, logo max height 56px. Using neutral gradient so quote is legible.

devin_marketing: If legal clears the quote, marketing will shorten to a 12–15 word pullquote for the hero card. Can we keep an editable text layer so we can A/B shorter phrasing?

kara_design: Yes — text layer is editable. Also adding a secondary micro-badge option: ‘Hosted on NexusCloud’ — should we include both badges? Feels busy.

sachin_legal: Only one micro-badge please. Our brand guideline prefers “Built with Redwood Inference” over “Powered by”. Also add a tiny legal line: “Trademark Redwood Inference™” and partner attribution. I’ll paste exact legal copy in a sec.

sachin_legal: Suggested legal footer (to use under artwork): “Redwood Inference™ and logos are trademarks of Redwood Inference, Inc. Use permitted under partner agreement. See full attribution in release notes.”

maria_partnerships: Timeline check — Nexus wants final assets by EOD Friday for next-Wed joint blog + marketplace tile. Can marketing/design commit?

devin_marketing: EOD Fri is tight but doable if legal confirms quote today. Marketing will prep 2 lengths of the quote and one 1-line microcopy.

kara_design: I can finalize export-ready PNG/SVGs by Friday afternoon. Will follow the legal footer spacing. Will also include a small CSS snippet for partners to keep spacing consistent.

kara_design: ```
/* lockup spacing guidance */
.lockup { position: absolute; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; }
.lockup img { height: 56px; max-width: 220px; }
.badge { font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.9; }
```

assets-bot: Uploaded preview images to Figma and exported low-res thumbnails to the shared drive: https://rwd-internal.s3/partners/nexus/previews

felix_partnerops: I'll chase Nexus legal and the PM for quote verification now. Also looping their brand contact so we avoid rework. Tagging @sachin_legal for final signoff when they reply.

maria_partnerships: Perfect — keep thread updated. If legal approves today, we’ll finalize assets and schedule the marketplace listing sync. :thumbsup:
